resources.name: DFT code (e.g., VASP or Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: Any DFT code capable of spin-polarized geometry optimization with pseudopotentials and PW91 functional. Quantum ESPRESSO is a free open-source alternative.
Use pseudopotentials appropriate for the chosen DFT code, such as ultrasoft pseudopotentials for VASP or ONCV/PBE for Quantum ESPRESSO.
